Bug_Title: Floating point numbers should not be tested for equality
Bug_Explanation: This code demonstrates the common mistake of using equality and inequality operators with floating point numbers. These operations are unreliable because floating point representations are imprecise, leading to unexpected results.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test cases trigger the bug by calling the 'showBug' method with values that involve floating point equality comparisons. These comparisons are inherently imprecise, causing the test assertions to fail.
